name: Jharia panel — 1:1000 diorama

georeference.comment: Fixed baseline. There is NO GPS module in this build — the site origin is a constant, and every node/junction/exit position is a metre offset from it.
georeference.metres_per_degree_lon_comment: cos(23.643°) x 111320 ≈ 102470 — computed for this latitude once so the GIS payload never does trig per request.
georeference.bearing_comment: 0° = the diorama's north edge is true north. d_n_m grows north, d_e_m grows east.

extents_m.comment: Working extent before the cm→m scale factor. Zones and link costs are expressed in these metres.

topology.comment: 4 sensor nodes · 2 level hubs · 1 main hub = 7 boards. Junctions are PASSIVE — wire and lamp only, no MCU of their own.

render.link_cost_comment: Metres of travel. Phase 7 replaces this with a hazard-weighted cost; the number here is the calm-conditions baseline.

dataset_provenance_note: Positions are PLACEHOLDERS until the diorama is laid out. Measure each point in cm from the SW corner and set d_e_m = x_cm x 10, d_n_m = y_cm x 10 — the same rule as tunnel_map.json.
